meaning.en: (US) The east side of a district or city.
meaning.vi: (Hoa Kỳ) Phía đông của một huyện hoặc thành phố.

sentences.en: Events Calendar Eastside is a treasure trove of hidden gems.

sentences.en: The Gardens at Eastside is a facility that provides assisted living and memory care in a warm and friendly atmosphere.

sentences.en: If you want to learn how to dance to swing music and want to take lessons in or near Seattle, it is a good idea to attend a few Eastside Seattle swing dance lessons.

sentences.en: While it is easy to get caught up in the fun of swing dancing, Eastside Seattle swing dance lessons will focus on dance technique and musicality.
sentences.vi: Mặc dù có thể dễ dàng bị cuốn vào niềm vui của môn khiêu vũ đu dây, nhưng các bài học về môn khiêu vũ đu dây ở Eastside Seattle sẽ tập trung vào kỹ thuật nhảy và tính âm nhạc.
Chào mừng đến với khu thương mại Eastside.

sentences.en: Robert Pickton made the Downtown Eastside infamous because he was suspected of killing dozens of female prostitutes and drug addicts he met here.

sentences.en: Junkies from the Downtown Eastside sometimes run through there, sometimes naked, at all hours, and each morning an employee is sent to collect the used needles lying on the ground.

sentences.en: But for the tribe of the upper - eastside of Manhattan, it takes just one person.
